items.title: D'Imperio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2014
items.q: the percussion leader, Sgt. Wadkowicz, he dragged me right into that room. He said, “I want to hear that flam accent man.”

ctx.x: the final table with the guys with the stamp. And I said I had to have failed, you know. He takes this stamp, I thought he was going to break the table. Bang! Fully qualified for military service. I said, “oh my God.” Here we go man. I mean even my eyes. I mean I used to wear glasses. I had 20/200 vision, a couple surgeries and cataract surgery, I’m 20/20 now you know, except I have to use reading glasses. So anyway, we get back up to Cortland, now my father owned a bar around the corner called the Crystal Hotel.…

Statue of Liberty, right where that thing I showed you there. So I had to enlist for three years in the Army, but that — and you’re guaranteed 14 months. Of course then there’s another 14 to go, that you can get a levy. You don’t get washed out, you are picked for a levy from Washington and it’s okay, somebody’s needed. So I went to basic training and as soon as I got down to Governor’s Island, Fort Jay, Governor’s Island, right across from the Statue of Liberty, the percussion leader, Sgt. Wadkowicz, he dragged…
